meta.dataNotes: FRESH research-stage screen (13 Jun 2026) of selected NSE small-caps, set apart from the prior shortlist (archived to data/archive/candidates-2026-06-13.json). These 5 names also seed the ₹50,000 conviction-weighted paper-trading book in data/paper-trades.json. Figures are point-in-time snapshots from authorised aggregators (Screener/Trendlyne/MoneyControl/MarketsMojo) on the dates in each 'sources' entry; they LAG live quotes and MUST be re-verified on NSE/BSE before any decision. Fundamental fields are well-sourced; several technical fields (exact 50/200-DMA, RSI) and a few estimated fundamentals are best-estimates pending the Yahoo/GitHub-Actions refresh, which overwrites CMP/technicals/surveillance with authoritative values. Surveillance flags set false were not individually confirmed for every name — verify on the NSE ASM/GSM report. Not financial advice.
meta.amfiCutoffNote: AMFI Jan 2026 reference: large = top 100 (floor ~Rs 1,05,000 cr), mid = ranks 101-250 (floor ~Rs 34,700 cr), small/micro = 251+ (below ~Rs 34,700 cr). All included names sit below the mid-cap floor. Re-verify against the live AMFI list.

thesis.core: Domestic market leader in industrial gears and a strong No.2 in material-handling equipment, debt-free with ~25% ROCE — a clean engineering compounder leveraged to the broad capex cycle across power, mining, cement, steel and defence.
thesis.catalysts: Order inflows from power/mining/cement/defence capex, margin-accretive gear mix, exports ramp and a growing service/spares annuity; consistent debt-free balance sheet supports re-rating.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Capex cycle stays firm so the order book keeps growing, gear-mix margins hold, and execution scales without a leveraged acquisition.
thesis.risks: Capex-cycle sensitivity, raw-material (steel) cost swings, export/FX exposure, and a valuation (P/E ~28) that already prices in quality.
thesis.invalidation: Order book stalling for 2+ quarters, OPM contraction >300bps for two quarters, any debt-funded M&A pushing D/E above 0.5, entry into ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

thesis.core: Integrated engineering player levered to the structural power-transmission & distribution (T&D) capex super-cycle — transmission towers, polymer pipes and EPC — with a high ROIC (~31%), no promoter pledge and a rapidly expanding order book.
thesis.catalysts: Record domestic grid-capex and export T&D orders, polymer (pipes) scale-up, PAT +63% in Q4; deleveraging as cash flow improves.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Grid-capex ordering stays strong and converts to executed revenue, working capital stays controlled, and margins keep rising as the mix improves.
thesis.risks: Working-capital intensity of EPC, commodity (steel/zinc) cost swings, execution/competition in tower EPC, and a valuation that needs continued >30% earnings growth.
thesis.invalidation: Order book stalling for 2+ quarters, OCF turning negative, D/E rising above 1.0, any promoter pledge appearing, entry into ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

sources.label: Screener.in / Trendlyne — SKIPPER
sources.note: CMP Rs 572.70, mcap ~Rs 6,443 cr, ROIC ~31%, no pledge, Q4 PAT +63%

thesis.core: Fast-growing B2B gold-jewellery manufacturer supplying large national retail chains, riding the structural formalisation of India's jewellery trade — with ~30% ROCE, no promoter pledge and a deleveraging balance sheet as scale and capital raises lower funding cost.
thesis.catalysts: New large-retailer relationships, capacity expansion, lightweight/CKM jewellery mix lifting realisations, and deleveraging; sales +77% in the latest period.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Wins keep widening the customer base, thin (~5%) margins hold or rise on mix, and working-capital/debt keep falling as a share of sales.
thesis.risks: Razor-thin margins typical of B2B jewellery, gold-price and working-capital intensity, customer concentration, and a rich valuation on a young, fast-scaling franchise.
thesis.invalidation: Margin contraction, working capital/debt re-expanding sharply, a large customer loss, OCF turning persistently negative, entry into ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

thesis.core: Global No.2 in composite (Type-IV) cylinders alongside a steady industrial-packaging (polymer drums/IBCs) cash franchise — debt-light (D/E ~0.25, debt/EBITDA ~0.8) and cheap, with embedded optionality on the H2/CNG/LPG composite-cylinder shift.
thesis.catalysts: Composite-cylinder orders for CNG/LPG/hydrogen, value-added product mix, deleveraging, and possible value-unlocking of the composites business; steady packaging cash flows fund the growth.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: Composite-cylinder demand scales (H2/CNG adoption), margins mix up, and the balance sheet keeps deleveraging while the core packaging business compounds.
thesis.risks: Crude/polymer cost swings, slower-than-hoped composite adoption, capital intensity, and modest ROCE (~15%) that needs the value-added mix to lift returns.
thesis.invalidation: ROCE falling below 12%, debt/EBITDA rising above 2.0, composite-segment growth stalling for 2+ quarters, OCF turning negative, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.

thesis.core: Pure-play, high-reliability EMS provider (aerospace, defence, medical, industrial) inside the Cyient ecosystem, riding India's electronics-manufacturing and 'build-in-India' boom — a record order book and a book-to-bill of ~1.46 underpin a multi-year revenue ramp; the highest-risk/highest-upside name in the set.
thesis.catalysts: Record order book conversion, EMS sector ~30% CAGR, operating leverage targeting a march toward ~25% ROCE, and new aerospace/defence/medical programmes.
thesis.whatMustGoRight: The order book converts on schedule, operating leverage lifts ROCE from ~10% toward the 20%+ target, working capital is contained, and the rich valuation is supported by sustained 30%+ growth.
thesis.risks: Low current ROCE (~10%), demanding valuation (P/E ~55), working-capital build, customer/programme concentration, and execution risk on a fast ramp — the speculative, highest-beta pick.
thesis.invalidation: Book-to-bill falling below 1.0, ROCE not improving over 12-18 months, working capital ballooning, OCF turning persistently negative, entry into ASM/GSM, or a decisive close below the 200-DMA.
